correctness.rationale: TARGET disproof verified independently. Baseline gamma_HRZ=1/2 at n=3 p=2 correctly instantiated from HRZ Thm 1.2 + Fig.1 (no n=3 improvement; proved exponent n-1-n/p=1/2). Bush T={T_e} with N~delta^{-2} direction-separated tubes through origin: each contains B(0,delta/4), so ||sum chi||_2 >= sqrt(pi/48) c0 delta^{-1/2} while (sum|T|)^{1/2}=O(1). Target demands <= C_eps delta^{-0.49-eps}(sum|T|)^{1/2}. At eps0=0.005 ratio R=K*C^{-1}*delta^{-0.005}->infinity; explicit crossing k>1190.7 for C=1 (k=1200 R~1.03, k=2000 R~16.5 verified by replayed script) and finite k*(C)=ln(C/K)/(0.005 ln2) for any fixed C, so no fixed C_eps rescues bound. Stickiness: coaxial lines p=0 Lipschitz graph over S^2, packing dim 2=n-1 per Wang-Zahl Def 1.1; fat/thin ratio (rho/delta)^2 gives M=O(1)<=min(10,delta^{-eta}). Maximal-operator form gives same 1/2 floor via f=chi_{B(0,delta)}. Union-volume non-equivalence honestly flagged: bush satisfies volume form with gamma=0, but L^2/operator half (the 0.01-gain content) is falsified, hence conjunction as stated is false. Constants c0=1/2, C2=20 generous absolute; radius conventions affect only K, not exponent. Script VERIFY_OK replayed.

originality.rationale: Headline audited is the negative TARGET resolution: sticky 0.49 L^2/operator improvement is FALSE, gamma=1/2 sharp on sticky families via sticky bush. Fused live retrieval (3 consolidated directions, SerpBase/OpenAlex/Crossref, no partial) + full-source checks found no prior source stating this sticky-quantified refutation. Classical Wolff bush sharpness (1995) predates Wang-Zahl sticky definition (2022) and does not certify bush satisfies Wang-Zahl Def 1.1 / QStick with M=O(1)<=10 nor address the admitted sticky 0.49 target; Wang-Zahl 2210.09581 proves sticky DIMENSION 3, not maximal L^2 floor (dimension does not imply maximal); HRZ 1908.05589 gives no n=3 improvement; Katz-Rogers/Guth-Zahl Wolff axioms carry degree-dependent constants and do not record sticky bush floor. No table/database lists the sticky bush maximal witness. The composition (bush + quantitative sticky verification + explicit k*(C) refutation of 0.49) is not found verbatim and not mechanically implied without the new stickiness/normalization checks. See decisive_checks for adversarial coverage tests.
